study_name: Phase 22 H1 R3 End-to-End Behavioral Utility & Gate 2 Recovery Study
operational_meaning: Empirical evaluation confirms that R3 (S + ternary direction) provides statistically robust downstream behavioral utility beyond scalar S alone under matched-magnitude conditions (|Si - Sj| <= 0.02). It recovers directional discrimination that scalar surprise collapses (79.89% recovery on discordant pairs), without causing policy chatter or runaway clarification. This evidence is sufficient to update the draft ADR-029 Evidence Ledger. CRITICAL: The Production Architecture Gate remains STRICTLY LOCKED. Production integration is NOT authorized.
